column1: # WAL market tracker — dated positioning and market readings, one row per reading (long format). LIVE ledger: `scripts/market_tracker.py --write` appends only new readings; `scripts/boot.py` flags a newer FINRA settlement or a snapshot older than 7 days. Built 2026-10-30 (Will: "we should track metrics like this").
# Last real data refresh: 2026-10-30 (scripts/market_tracker.py --write) | Staleness sweep (no data): not advanced

# Metrics: short_interest_shares · avg_daily_volume · days_to_cover (FINRA consolidated short interest, semi-monthly) · shares_outstanding (SEC XBRL dei cover-page counts) · short_pct_shares_out (short ÷ the latest cover count dated on or before the settlement) · weekly snapshot: close_WAL, close_KRE, close_WAL-PA, realized_vol_20d/60d (annualized, backward-looking), beta_KRE_60d, spot_vs_ev_pct (EV from THESIS.md at run time).

# Owner: WAL (single-name only). Cohort and KRE judgments → REGINALD; implied volatility → TERRY (card-time pulls). Rule of thumb for short_pct_shares_out (not peer data): <5% low · 5–10% moderate · >10% heavy. Never hand-edit a row; a correction is a new dated row with Basis saying what it corrects.
